<h1>Autodrop</h1>

## Purpose

A comprehensive, **modifier-free manual autodrop surface** complementing
the LC bottom row: toggle which sequencers are eligible for automatic
autodrop cycles, and directly cue mute / CC / note autodrops per sequencer
or per TR-8 voice. Autodrops temporarily flip a sequencer/voice's state and
revert automatically at the next timing point.

## Interaction

Both LPs of both players show the same layout. Sequencer-cue cells show
slate grey when ready, flash the flavour colour when cued (mute = tan,
CC = burnt orange, note = yellow), and go solid while the drop is in flight.
Eligibility cells (row 8) show the sequencer's own colour when on.

> **Note and CC cues on a synth sequencer do not silence anything yet.** The
> cue arms, the LEDs move, and the sequencer keeps playing as though unmuted.
> TR-8 voices and the master bus do fire real note/CC drops. Automatic cycles
> only ever mute a synth. See [Autodrops](/documentation/MSEQ/autodrops).

## Shortcuts

### LHS: sequencers 1–7

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row 8, cols 1–7 | LP LHS | Toggle autodrop **eligibility** for seqs 1–7 | none |
| Press row 7, cols 1–7 | LP LHS | Cue **mute autodrop** for seqs 1–7 (re-press cancels) | none |
| Press row 6, cols 1–7 | LP LHS | Cue **CC autodrop** for seqs 1–7 | none |
| Press row 5, cols 1–7 | LP LHS | Cue **note autodrop** for seqs 1–7 | none |

### RHS: sequencers 9–12 + TR-8

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row 8, cols 1–4 | LP RHS | Toggle eligibility for seqs 9–12 | none |
| Press rows 5–7, cols 1–4 | LP RHS | Cue mute/CC/note autodrop for seqs 9–12 | none |
| Press row 8, cols 5–6 | LP RHS | Toggle TR-8 bus eligibility | none |
| Press col 5, rows 1–7 | LP RHS | Cue TR-8 **main** voices (BD/SD/LT/MT/HT); re-press toggles back | none |
| Press col 6, rows 1–7 | LP RHS | Cue TR-8 **alt** voices (RS/HC/CH/OH/CY) | none |

### Shared behaviour

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Re-press a cued cell (same flavour) | LP grid | Cancel the cue | none |
| Press a different-flavour row while cued | LP grid | Replace the cue if the new drop length ≥ existing | none |

> A drop already in flight cannot be cancelled: the engine rejects the
> press. Rows 1–4 on the LHS, col 8/9 cells, and the boom-tsk/ghost-RS
> voices are no-ops by design.
